title: Aurum Alpha structured log line
description: One JSON object per line, to stdout. Governed by standards/service.md SC2; the timestamp comes from the identifiers contract and the context block from the observability contract, referenced rather than restated. schemaVersion 1 — evolves additively per PC6.

level.description: Five levels, no more (SC2). The emitting threshold is configuration, never an environment the code detected.

msg.description: A short, stable, human-readable statement of what happened. Variable parts belong in their own fields, so lines about the same event group.

service.description: The service's stable name, identical to the provenance block's service (SC5).

error.description: Present on error and fatal lines. A stack trace is a field here, never additional lines (SC2): a pipeline splits on newlines, and a raw trace becomes many unattributed lines nothing can join back.

allOf.description: OC4: within request context, the context block is required. A line carrying any request-scoped id must carry the floor pair.
